walk_forward.purge: Remove training samples with future_datetime >= evaluation start.

preprocessing: Median imputation; weekday most-frequent imputation and one-hot encoding. Logistic numeric features additionally standardized. All fit inside each fold or full-train final fit.

thresholds.selection_source: Training-only OOF confidence-score quantiles among actual UP/DOWN OOF rows; no validation labels used to set thresholds.
thresholds.coverage_reference: Eligible directional examples; all-candle coverage and neutral false signals are also reported.
thresholds.tie_policy: Predict DOWN on equal class probabilities; score ties can increase realized coverage.

selection_rule: At 30% OOF eligible-direction coverage, rank by mean fold eligible-only directional macro precision, then emitted eligible directional accuracy, then unthresholded accuracy. Prefer candidates with mean eligible-direction coverage >=20%; otherwise report coverage shortfall.
validation_use: One final confirmation after training-only selection. Not pristine holdout due prior project research.
